note: The two samples are identical except for one duplicated, low-value claim: A renders the frameless-glass design value as the mid-word truncation 'FRAMLESS GLASS DESIG' while B renders it 'FRAMLESS GLASS'. Both sets make the same misbindings (the 'SOLAR ARRAY MOUNTING RAILS' leader treated as a connection of SA3-1 and SA3-2), the same truncated model value ('SUNPREME GX290 SOLA'), and the same duplicates (model and design each stated under both 'PV Module' and 'solar module'; bare 'value | 3' claims repeating 'internal value | 3'). Neither omits an engineering fact the other captures, so the sets are effectively equivalent in correctness.
remarks: Both extractions treat the '3' inside each hexagon inconsistently — as 'internal value', bare 'value', and 'quantity' — while the legend shows the hexagon-with-3 is the SUNPREME GX290 solar module symbol, i.e. a per-string module count; a single consistent attribute would be better. The 'SOLAR ARRAY MOUNTING RAILS' text is a general leader note about the array, not a connection of SA3-1/SA3-2. The text layer is heavily fragmented (polarity marks and labels separated from their symbols), so terminal/connection claims could not be fully verified from text alone and were judged mainly on plausibility against the image.
